title: Local square-root weak-strong L2 stability for bounded positive Hartree solutions with Coulomb or gravitational interaction
difficulty_reason: 扣去旧2161的平方根/I1+I2模板和外引Lemma 2.1给出的I1后，I2仍涉及非交换乘积v v2的对角密度，不能由旧的经典速度混合范数结论直接代入解决。 作者在544–580行把势交换子的两点核写为线段上场梯度与量子速度梯度的乘积，沿x+theta y、x−(1−theta)y切片取得空间L3控制，再在567–574行辨认切片x导数为两核变量导数之和，恰好对应量子x梯度。HLS与Sobolev被扣除后，保留的是所需核/量子梯度范数之间的具体桥梁。 518–525行的非交换乘积密度控制与该桥梁相接，产生仅用强解量子正则性、空间密度上界和弱差L2的闭合。此处不是将古典证明重新命名，也不是仅凭Coulomb或Schatten术语升级。
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 10 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.230
source_title: On the $L^2$ rate of convergence in the limit from the Hartree to the Vlasov–Poisson equation

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Global mild solutions and the semiclassical limit for the Fermi--Dirac BGK model
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual lem:3-mom is a spatially localized third-moment estimate for damped free transport with a nonnegative source, not square-root Hartree stability or positive-quantization semiclassical convergence.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Local Well-Posedness for Vlasov--Poisson with $L^{d+}$ Initial Density and Fractional Velocity Regularity
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual lem:twist reparametrizes classical characteristic maps under a small integrated C1,alpha field and controls its Jacobian. It is distinct from two-point operator kernels and the Wick-square density forcing.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Low regularity Sobolev well-posedness for Vlasov--Poisson
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual localized integrated averaging lemma estimates a velocity average for transport with divergence source and bounded velocity support; it is not the operator weak-strong or Hartree-to-Vlasov primary.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Global existence of Lagrangian solutions to the ionic Vlasov--Poisson system
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual lem:C1 bounds a torus ionic-Poisson constant in terms of rho L1 and Gamma. It does not contain either current selected primary.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Dynamical low-rank approximation for the semiclassical Schrodinger equation with uncertainties
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual lemma supplies K/S/L projector-splitting evolution of a fixed-rank approximation, not a singular Coulomb operator stability or semiclassical convergence theorem.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Commutator Estimates for Low-Temperature Fermi Gases
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual selected lemma is an exponential lattice-sum moment bound in delta,sigma,p. The same authors and commutator paper title do not make that retained primary a duplicate of the two current cores.

exact_primary_comparisons.title: Uniform semiclassical nonlinear Hartree phase mixing and weighted scattering for small perturbations
exact_primary_comparisons.owner_comparison: Actual maintained primary is nonlinear phase mixing/weighted scattering for small perturbations of a translation-invariant equilibrium under uniform Penrose stability, d>=3 and Fourier-decaying L1 interaction. It is not the finite trace positive-density Coulomb/gravitational square-root comparison or O(hbar) classical limit.

normal_observations_not_author_gaps: Old2161 I1/Lorentz pairing and h3/h3/2 kernel normalization are retained normal conventions, not new gaps or old proof review.

Source838 has the factor3hbar/2 outside the parentheses, multiplying both terms; rawSNP8 missing-hbar claim withdrawn.
Source522 L2_y norm is a function of x; the density identification is not made into a new omission.
Standard norm inclusions, adjoints, equivalent momentum weights, loose constants and Gaussian moment factors are distinguished from the retained literal source observations.

scope_and_claim_limits.observation: 作者说阶hbar预计最优；本文所给材料不能因此改写为已证明最优性。
时间系数可能增长快于双指数；Hartree–Fock只是remark，其exchange处理外引旧文，不增加一个本篇完整原生证明。
H1/2改进只在remark说明可从插值看出；量子Hartree稳定性明确局部时间，作者明确说Coulomb Hartree的全局uniform-h regularity尚未知。
末节只对由足够光滑经典Vlasov解驱动的线性辅助演化传播量子正则性，不是对非线性Coulomb Hartree全局传播作新结论。

external_proof_inputs.author_boundary: Lemma 2.1明确为旧文Proposition 4.3及缩放说明。
B_f bound、初始量子Sobolev有界性与经典场/二阶正则性分别外引lafleche_strong_2021。
complex bilinear interpolation本身只引Bergh §4.4；本篇给出待插值的两个端点。
初态量子Sobolev控制与regularity proof中权重、范数演化、高阶势交换子依赖旧文工具。

abbreviated_or_not_separately_expanded_s.author_boundary: Lemma 3.2陈述r的H2控制；其proof写出L2 multiplier估计与r2式后结束，未另列对r的二阶导数估计。仅记录作者展开程度，不补证或认定缺口。
左右乘权版本由取伴随说明，第二种权重余项以similar computation及same reasoning结束；保留原有省略，不把普通伴随/标准计算另造高级难点。
Lemma 3.5对初始双侧加权误差直接回引Lemma 3.4；后者明示估计的是Wick平方与Wick(g²)之差。该处没有另外逐行重写Wick(g²)与Weyl(g²)的双侧加权部分。只记录回引的精确范围，不补上作者未写的项，也不据此裁定真假。
regularity proof先在q≥2写范数演化，并在1129行注明r条件及k>j；随后以recycling the above argument给出其他梯度耦合并直接Gronwall。对更广陈述范围没有另列分情形证明。仅记录作者文字，不新增q/k假设或补齐端点。
J项合并、对角界进入强迫稳定性和最终求和均由作者直接结束；它们是内部支持链的闭合/后果，不因未再逐式展开就另认缺口。

core_obligations: 扣去旧2161的平方根/I1+I2模板和外引Lemma 2.1给出的I1后，I2仍涉及非交换乘积v v2的对角密度，不能由旧的经典速度混合范数结论直接代入解决。 作者在544–580行把势交换子的两点核写为线段上场梯度与量子速度梯度的乘积，沿x+theta y、x−(1−theta)y切片取得空间L3控制，再在567–574行辨认切片x导数为两核变量导数之和，恰好对应量子x梯度。HLS与Sobolev被扣除后，保留的是所需核/量子梯度范数之间的具体桥梁。 518–525行的非交换乘积密度控制与该桥梁相接，产生仅用强解量子正则性、空间密度上界和弱差L2的闭合。此处不是将古典证明重新命名，也不是仅凭Coulomb或Schatten术语升级。
